title: Agency Dealership vs. Approved Repair Facility
citation: UAE Unified Motor Vehicle Insurance Policy (CBUAE Standard), Chapter 1, Section 2, Article 1(b) & Dealership Endorsement
text: Accident repairs are performed at the vehicle manufacturer's authorized main dealership (Agency Repair) if the Agency Repair endorsement is active in the policy schedule and the vehicle is within its designated eligibility period (typically 1 to 3 years from first registration). For all other vehicles, repairs are executed at insurer-certified independent collision repair centers meeting national regulatory benchmarks.
